text: Artificial intelligence, or AI, is the ability of machines to perform tasks that usually require human intelligence. These tasks include learning, problem-solving, and understanding language. A key part of AI is machine learning, where computers learn from data instead of following strict rules. For example, by seeing thousands of photos, a system can learn to recognize cats. A more advanced type is deep learning, which uses layers of artificial neural networks to handle complex patterns, like understanding speech. You use AI every day, often without noticing. When your phone predicts your next word, when a streaming service suggests a movie, or when a navigation app finds the fastest route, that is AI working quietly in the background.
